scope: One owning correction, group ownership invariant and changed dependency closure.
report:
**GREEN.** The round-1 I1 defect is closed. A path that is outside in any porcelain record is removed from the selection, and that veto also covers generated writes.

Observed route: grok/grok-4.7, reasoning effort high. Session `776227ae-da67-4a54-a1b8-3bc4fd4289a8`.

`gitops.py:200-215` builds `selected` and `outside` from every group, then `selected.difference_update(outside)`. Automatic `.gitattributes` is added only when that path is not outside, so a rename of the attributes file does not recreate it. The commit pathspec is that final `selected` list. The recreated-source case (`src/old.txt` renamed to `outside.txt`, then recreated untracked) stays outside; the staged rename remains, and only the other owned path is committed. V1 `test_cross_scope_rename_with_recreated_source_stays_outside` and `test_renamed_attributes_outside_are_not_recreated` pass.

Foreign staged content still survives the private index and `commit --only`. `PlanLock` still covers status through the HEAD read (`gitops.py:184-273`). The real `index.lock` still covers add, commit, publication, and the HEAD read (`gitops.py:230-272`). V1 is 28 tests OK, V4 prints `ok`, and V5 is 5 tests OK.

## Notes

- `gitops.py:270` still uses `.strip()` for the HEAD SHA. Root and git-path decoding use `removesuffix("\n")`. The SHA is hexadecimal, so trailing-space paths are unaffected.
- Invalid UTF-8 `.gitattributes` raises `CONTENT_INVALID` before the outside-scope check. Both refusals happen before any helper write.
- The reviewer documentation sentence was named in the closure and was not part of this read batch.
